ideas.name: SK Hynix Inc. (NASDAQ ADR)
ideas.thesis: SKHY appeared in all 6 of 6 overnight screening runs — the strongest consensus on the watchlist. The stock trades at ~$177 against a 13-analyst consensus price target of $247.31, a 39.7% upside gap with zero sell-side Sell ratings. SK Hynix holds 33% global DRAM share, is the sole HBM4 supplier for Nvidia's next-gen Rubin architecture, posted a record 76% Q2 operating margin, and has a 40 trillion won buyback plus Temasek capital injection providing balance-sheet support. A benign CPI print Sept 11 and/or Fed hold Sept 16 are the near-term re-rating triggers for a name that is acutely rate/macro sensitive.

ideas.bear_case: Memory names are acutely macro-sensitive — a hot CPI print and confirmed 25bp hike on Sept 16 could pressure the ADR regardless of fundamentals; NASDAQ ADR options liquidity is still developing, limiting defined-risk entries.

ideas.name: Apple Inc.
ideas.thesis: AAPL appeared in 5 of 6 overnight runs as a same-day binary catalyst play around the 'Surprise and Shine' event live TODAY Sept 9 at 10AM PT, featuring the first-ever foldable iPhone Ultra (priced $2,099–$2,299) and iPhone 18 Pro. ideas.edge: Stock at ~$316 vs. KeyBanc bear PT of $250 (-21% downside) and historically negative post-event drift (-0.72% day-of, -1.22% five days post); IV elevated intraday creating straddle or post-event IV-crush opportunity; foldable component costs up 38% YoY
ideas.bull_case: First foldable iPhone Ultra is a category-expansion supercycle opener not fully priced into fundamentals; strong Q3 results (EPS +29% YoY) provide a floor, and pre-order + Sept 18 sale momentum could sustain a rally into October.
ideas.bear_case: Historical event-day weakness, a 38% component cost surge threatening foldable margins, standard iPhone 18 delayed to Spring 2027 reducing near-term volume, and a credible $250 bear PT all skew risk to the downside; a hawkish Fed on Sept 16 compounds consumer discretionary pressure.

ideas.thesis: QQQ appeared in 4 of 6 overnight runs as the cleanest defined-risk vehicle to express directional uncertainty around twin binary macro events: August CPI on Sept 11 at 8:30AM ET and the FOMC decision Sept 15–16. Kalshi markets imply a near-coin-flip 56%/44% hike-vs-hold outcome, and CPI above 0.3% MoM is priced at 60% — meaning a hot print is the base case but far from certain. A straddle or strangle through Sept 17 expiry captures either direction; a put spread through Sept 19 works as a portfolio hedge against the tech longs on this watchlist.
